xDraft by xDev

Support

Contact us: duy@xdev.asia. Please tell us your device, its system version and the app version (Settings ▸ About in the app). Do not send map content unless you want us to see it.

Where are my maps and diagrams?

On your device, and in your private iCloud account while you are signed in to iCloud. xDraft has no account and no xDev servers. See the privacy policy.

What can I make?

Mind maps, flowcharts, architecture diagrams with C4 and Deployment views, and sequence diagrams. Choose New from Template to start from a finished example. Check Diagram lists what a flowchart or an architecture diagram leaves open and offers fixes; the Architecture Document turns an architecture model into a document you export as PDF or Markdown. On iPad, Sketch to Diagram turns a flowchart drawn with Apple Pencil into one you can edit; it needs Apple Pencil.

My maps don't appear on my other device.

Sign in to the same Apple Account on both devices. On a Mac, check that iCloud Sync is on in xDraft ▸ Settings ▸ Data; on iPhone and iPad, check that iCloud is on for xDraft in the Settings app. Use the same version of xDraft on every device: diagrams made in version 2.0 or later may not appear in older versions. Sync can take a few minutes after a change, and needs a network connection.

What does xDraft Pro add?

Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Every plan adds architecture diagrams with their C4, Deployment and Sequence views, the Architecture Document and Design Review Deck, conversions, high-resolution and multi-page export, more themes, voice input and advanced AI. Mind maps and flowcharts are free. Without Pro, architecture documents still open and export. Every plan unlocks Pro on Mac, iPad and iPhone with the same Apple Account, and Lifetime works with Family Sharing. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings, or with Manage Subscription in Settings ▸ Pro.

I bought Pro but it is locked.

Open Settings ▸ Pro and choose Restore Purchases, signed in to the Apple Account you bought it with. For a family member, Family Sharing covers Lifetime only, and sharing purchases must be on.

Why don't I see AI features?

AI features need Apple Intelligence, which runs on the device. They appear only on devices that support Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on in system settings, and in a language it supports. On other devices the AI features are hidden; everything else works.

The app says it can't open my maps.

Quit and reopen the app. If the message comes back, contact us and mention that message; do not delete the app, because deleting it removes the maps stored on the device.

How do I delete my data?

Delete maps and diagrams in the app; they wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days, or use Delete Permanently there to remove them now. Deleting the app removes the documents stored on that device; documents in iCloud can be removed in your device's iCloud storage settings.
